oneOf.description: A completed CLI session MUST deliver api_key only while the original authorizing membership remains active and bound to the same organization and the issued key remains active, unrevoked, unexpired, with persisted scopes that remain a non-empty unique subset of the current allowlist. Membership and key state MUST be row-locked in the same serializable delivery transaction. API-key expiry MUST be evaluated after the referenced key row lock is acquired, using a non-transaction-start persistence wall clock in the same serializable transaction; transaction-start timestamps and service-process clock comparisons are forbidden. Malformed, empty, duplicate, or retired key scopes MUST fail closed before delivery or erasure. The encrypted delivery copy MUST be authenticated with associated data binding the session_code, organization_id, and key_id; swapping the ciphertext or any binding field between sessions MUST fail closed before plaintext delivery or erasure. The decrypted api_key MUST hash to the referenced active key_id before delivery or erasure. The provider MUST validate the complete completed-session response against this authority before erasing the encrypted delivery copy or committing the delivery transaction; response-validation failure MUST roll back without erasure. API-key delivery is one-time. Session expiry MUST be evaluated after the session row lock is acquired, using a non-transaction-start persistence wall clock in the same transaction for authorization and polling; transaction-start timestamps and service-process clock comparisons are forbidden. After acquiring every relevant blocking membership, session, tenant-quota, and referenced-key lock, the provider MUST re-evaluate session expiry with a non-transaction-start persistence wall clock immediately before authorization commit, replay response, plaintext delivery, or delivery-copy erasure; expiry MUST roll back without key insertion, session mutation, disclosure, or erasure.
